cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Chris，欢迎回到 Clickspring
cues.en: G'day chris here and welcome back to clickspring

cues.zh: 在这期视频中，我制作了一个小齿轮模块，用于模拟古希腊人对月球不规则运动的认知
cues.en: In this video I make the small gearing module that models the ancient Greek understanding of the variable motion of the moon

cues.zh: 用现代天文学术语来说，这种变速运动包含两个组成部分
cues.en: In modern astronomical terms, there are two components to this variable motion

cues.zh: 其一是月球在如今我们所知的椭圆轨道上运行时，速度产生的轻微变化
cues.en: There's the slight variation in speed as the moon follows what we now understand to be in elliptical orbit

cues.zh: 其二是该轨道轴线缓慢的进动，它会略微
cues.en: and then there's the slow procession of the axis of that orbit that slightly

cues.zh: 延长月球回到轨道内同一位置所需的时间
cues.en: Extends the time it takes for the moon to come back to the same place within the orbit itself

cues.zh: 这被称为近点月
cues.en: this is known as the anomalistic month and

cues.zh: 而这种运动通过两个独立的输入，巧妙地复刻在机械装置下一部分的齿轮组中
cues.en: The motion is neatly captured within the gearing of this next part of the mechanism using two separate inputs

cues.zh: 第一个输入是月球的平恒星月周期，它驱动 E 组件平台上的一颗齿轮
cues.en: The first input is the mean sidereal period of the moon and it drives a gear on the e assembly platform

cues.zh: 这颗齿轮顶面带有一根小销钉
cues.en: That is a small pin on its upper face

cues.zh: 该销钉卡入正上方齿轮的狭缝中，两者一同旋转
cues.en: The pin fits into a small slot on a gear located directly above it and the two rotate together

cues.zh: 通常情况下，这样设计毫无意义
cues.en: Ordinarily this would serve no purpose

cues.zh: 但带有销钉的齿轮与带狭缝的齿轮，两者的旋转轴心略有偏差
cues.en: But the gear with the pin turns on a slightly offset access to that of the gear with the slot

cues.zh: 因此当它们一同转动时，带狭缝的齿轮被迫以可变速度运转
cues.en: So that as they turn together the slot gear is forced to travel at a variable speed

cues.zh: 我添加了参考线，以展示带狭缝的齿轮
cues.en: I've added reference lines to show how the slot gear

cues.zh: 在每转一圈的过程中，是如何在略微领先和略微落后主动齿轮之间交替波动的
cues.en: Oscillates between being slightly ahead and then slightly behind the driving gear as it goes through each revolution

cues.zh: 销槽齿轮在插销最靠近转动轴时转得最快，离得最远时转得最慢
cues.en: The slot gear travels fastest when the pin is closest to the axis of rotation and slowest when it's farthest away

cues.zh: 结果就是，原本平均的恒星月周期现在有了周期性变化
cues.en: With the result being that the mean sidereal period now has a cyclical variation to it

cues.zh: 与此同时，制作者巧妙地设计了第二路输入，用来驱动安装这些齿轮的底盘
cues.en: now at the same time the maker contrived a second input to drive the platform upon which these gears are mounted

cues.zh: 从而为这个变速运动引入了第二个分量，并且
cues.en: introducing a second component to the variable motion and

cues.zh: 大家还记得前几期视频中，那个53齿齿轮在默冬章和沙罗周期的轮系计算中都被抵消掉了
cues.en: You recall from previous videos that the 53 tooth gear cancelled out of each of the metonic and Sarah strained calculations

cues.zh: 但在这部分轮系的计算中它依然保留着，实际上它的作用现在揭晓了，就是用来辅助
cues.en: that it remains in the calculation for this section of the train and in fact its purpose is now revealed to assist in

cues.zh: 计算出正确的月球轨道进动周期
cues.en: Calculating the correct period for the precession of the lunar orbit

cues.zh: 通过将插销-销槽齿轮组以行星齿轮的形式安装在这个底盘上
cues.en: By mounting the pin and slot gearing epicyclicly on this platform

cues.zh: 月球运动的这两个可变分量便结合在一起，模拟出了近点月
cues.en: The two variable components of the lunar motion are now combined to model the anomalistic month

cues.zh: 更绝的是，这个输出随后通过
cues.en: And as if that wasn't impressive enough the output was then sent via

cues.zh: 同轴轴杆反向穿过输入轴套，并且
cues.en: coaxial shaft back through the input hub and

cues.zh: 传递给另一根轴，用来驱动机械装置正面的月相显示组件
cues.en: Handed off to another shaft that drove the lunar phase assembly on the front face of the mechanism

cues.zh: 在安提基特拉沉船残骸中发现它之前，古典文献就已经暗示过类似的机械
cues.en: Prior to its discovery amid the antique ether wreckage the classical texts had already suggested that something along these lines

cues.zh: 在古代确实存在过。例如西塞罗的记述
cues.en: existed in antiquity. For example the account from Cicero

cues.zh: 因此有人认为，在那个时期发现某种数学计算齿轮的实物证据，本就在意料之中
cues.en: Someone could be argued that the physical evidence of mathematical gearing of some sort should have been expected from the period

cues.zh: 但史料中没有任何记载表明，它会是这副模样
cues.en: But there was nothing on the record to suggest that it would be anything like this

cues.zh: 如此精密的设计，模拟了一个用语言都很难讲清的天文概念，更不用说用齿轮了
cues.en: such a sophisticated design modeling an astronomical concept that's hard enough to describe with words let alone gears and

cues.zh: 其工艺之娴熟自信，唯有深厚的经验与精湛的精密机械制造造诣才能铸就
cues.en: Executed with a technical confidence that can only come from long experience and a deep knowledge of the craft of constructing find mechanism

cues.zh: 这自然会让人得出结论：它是某种成熟工程传统的产物
cues.en: Which naturally leads to the conclusion that it was the product of a well-established

cues.zh: 这一工程传统的广度与能力，远超我们以往的想象，而我们目前对它知之甚少
cues.en: engineering tradition that was much broader and more capable than had been previously imagined and about which we presently know very little

cues.zh: 正是这最后一个事实，意味着很多时候只能靠机械结构本身来还原这段历史
cues.en: And that final fact means that it largely falls to the mechanism itself to tell the story

cues.zh: 去暗示当时所用的工具，并引导人们去推测
cues.en: to hint at the tools used and to guide the speculation

cues.zh: 这样一台机器究竟是如何在两千多年前被制造出来的
cues.en: about how such a machine might have been created more than two thousand years ago

cues.zh: 这个小轮毂，构成了我在上一期视频结尾所介绍的
cues.en: This small hub forms the basis of the component that I introduced at

cues.zh: 平太阴恒星月输入组件的基础
cues.en: the end of the previous video the mean lunar sidereal input assembly

cues.zh: 切出平面后，齿轮上的孔也加工成与之匹配的形状
cues.en: And with the flats formed the holes in the wheels were formed to match

cues.zh: 较小的那个永久固定在轮毂上，较大的则可拆卸，以便从 e 平台上拆下
cues.en: The smaller one to be a permanent fit on the hub and the larger removable to permit disassembly from the e platform

cues.zh: 这个小组件在 e 轴上旋转，该轴是销槽模块的最终输出端，与此同时
cues.en: This small assembly rotates on the e Arbor which is the final output of the pin and slot module and at the same time

cues.zh: 它也是 e 平台的主轴承表面。这就让该轴处于一个相当复杂的同轴结构中心
cues.en: It's the primary bearing surface for the e platform. So that puts the the Arbor at the center of quite a complex coaxial structure

cues.zh: 心轴上的各个台阶轴肩，还负责设定轮系这一部分的垂直间隙
cues.en: The various steps shoulders on the Arbor are also responsible for setting vertical clearances throughout this section of the train

cues.zh: 这一切都让它成为这台机器中最关键的部件之一
cues.en: All of which makes it one of the most critical components of the machine

cues.zh: 这根心轴承载着两个齿轮
cues.en: This Arbor carries two wheels

cues.zh: 较大的齿轮接收销槽机构的输出，较小的齿轮则将该旋转传递给月相轴
cues.en: The larger one receives the output of the pin and slot mechanism and the smaller one hands off that rotation to the lunar phase shaft

cues.zh: 为了更方便观察，这里去掉了较大的 E 平台部件，带大家近距离看看这组同心组件是如何装配在一起的
cues.en: And here's a closer look at how this set of concentric assemblies comes together with the larger e platform components absent to make it easier to view

cues.zh: 这是一套由台阶轴肩和轴承面构成的复杂叠构，它们的作用是让各个齿轮和组件
cues.en: It's a complex stack of step shoulders and bearing surfaces that all serve to keep the various wheels and assemblies

cues.zh: 不仅保持良好的啮合对齐，还能彼此保持适当的间距，从而以最小的摩擦力运转
cues.en: not only aligned for meshing, but also appropriately separated from each other and so operating at minimum friction

cues.zh: 销槽轮直接与这组齿轮配合，当然也需要一些专门的安装五金件才能按预期工作
cues.en: The pin and slot wheels interface directly with this stack of gears and of course need some specific mounting hardware to perform as intended

cues.zh: 首先是偏心枢轴
cues.en: starting with the eccentric pivot

cues.zh: 枢轴完成后，构成销槽模块的各个组件被组装在一起，并手工装配到位
cues.en: And with that pivot complete the various components that make up the pin and slot module were brought together to be hand fitted into position

cues.zh: E 平台上的枢轴位置，是通过测量销轮与月球恒星输入轮的啮合齿距来确定的
cues.en: The pivot location on the e platform was determined by depthing the pinwheel with the lunar sidereal input wheel and

cues.zh: 而且和这套机构的其他部分一样，这种啮合齿距只需通过直接观察和一个简单的工具就能确定
cues.en: Again much like the rest of the mechanism that depth thing can be determined using direct observation and a simple tool

cues.zh: 在确认轮子的深度后，接下来制作了销和槽的特征
cues.en: With the depthing of the wheels confirmed the pin and slot features were formed next

cues.zh: 其他关键的安装硬件是凸耳和桥接带，用于将销和槽轮固定在正确位置
cues.en: The other key pieces of mounting hardware are the lugs and bridge strap that serve to restrain the pin and slot wheels in position

cues.zh: 桥接带似乎是用薄金属板弯曲成形的
cues.en: The strap appears to have been bent to shape from a thin section of sheet metal

cues.zh: 所以我做了一套简单的成形工具，我认为它们有可能被用来塑造这个零件
cues.en: So I've made a set of simple forming tools that I think could have plausibly been used to shape the part

cues.zh: 固定凸耳的制作方式与用于固定e平台的那些相同
cues.en: The retaining lugs were formed in the same way as those used to fasten the e platform together

cues.zh: 并使用桥接带确定了它们在e平台上的位置
cues.en: and the bridge strap was used to identify their position on the e platform

cues.zh: 在确认桥接带的配合后，两个固定凸耳和偏心枢轴被永久固定到位
cues.en: After confirming the fit of the bridge strap the two retaining lugs and the eccentric pivot were permanently fastened into place

cues.zh: e心轴上的固定销孔也已形成，顶部的那个对于将整个组件固定到位至关重要
cues.en: The holes for the retaining pins in the e arbor were also formed, the top one being essential to retaining the entire assembly in place

cues.zh: 当机器倒置时
cues.en: When the machine is inverted

cues.zh: 至此，这个复杂组件的主要部件就完成了，下面是它们如何组装在一起
cues.en: And with that the main components of this complex assembly are complete so here's how it all goes together

cues.zh: 这台机器的这一部分有些不寻常，因为它可以被视为一个独立的模块
cues.en: This part of the machine is a little unusual in the sense that it can be considered a self-contained module

cues.zh: 因此与大多数机构不同，它的性能可以独立于机器的其余部分进行检查和评估
cues.en: So unlike most of the mechanism it's performance can be examined that assessed independently from the rest of the machine

cues.zh: 就像机械钟表一样，此时的主要挑战是识别组件中任何局部的卡滞现象
cues.en: Much like a mechanical clock the main challenge at this point is to identify any localized binding of the components

cues.zh: 所以很容易想象，在原始装置上进行这样的测试
cues.en: So it's easy to imagine testing like this being carried out on the original device

cues.zh: 检查活动自由度，并在最终装入机构之前观察销钉和滑块的操作
cues.en: Checking for freedom of movement and observing the pin and slider operation before it was finally installed within the mechanism

cues.zh: 这就迎来了重建过程中的一个关键时刻
cues.en: And this brings us to a key moment of the reconstruction

cues.zh: 因为这是第一次，装置的很大一部分可以作为一个运转中的机构来查看和操作
cues.en: Because for the first time a significant portion of the device can be viewed and operated as a functioning mechanism

cues.zh: 正如预期的那样，由于这一部分加入了齿轮传动，摩擦力增大了
cues.en: As expected the friction has increased due to the nature of the gearing that's been added in this section

cues.zh: 但它仍保持在可接受的水平
cues.en: But it remains at an acceptable level

cues.zh: 输入端手感轻巧，齿轮传动活动顺畅舒适，而且
cues.en: the input has a light feel and there's a comfortable free movement of the gearing and

cues.zh: 虽然这个搭建还有很长的路要走，但制作者的完整构想现在开始显现
cues.en: Although there's still a long way to go in this build, the full vision of the maker is now starting to emerge

cues.zh: 一个紧凑的机械平台，在其之上，当时最先进的
cues.en: of a compact mechanical platform upon which then state-of-the-art

cues.zh: 天文概念可以被呈现出来，并组合成一个单一的
cues.en: astronomical concepts could be represented and combined into a single

cues.zh: 包罗万象的
cues.en: all-encompassing

cues.zh: 宇宙模型
cues.en: model of the cosmos

cues.zh: 感谢观看，回头见
cues.en: Thanks for watching I'll see you later
